summary: Air T, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 7 to its Alerus Credit Agreement, entered into on September 1, 2026, by its subsidiaries as borrowers and the company as guarantor. The amendment terminates a temporary overline, increases the revolving credit commitment from $20 million to $25 million, extends the termination date to August 27, 2029, and revises borrowing base advance rates. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are indicated.
